# Issue #5211 — [Bug] loader.js source mapping issue when loader.config with custom source map files in 0.55.1

[https://github.com/microsoft/monaco-editor/issues/5211](https://github.com/microsoft/monaco-editor/issues/5211)

## Summary

Verified duplicate of the broader open source-map packaging issue: both reports result from emitted `min-maps` references whose files are absent from the package.

## Change summary

Vite reports a missing `loader.js.map` when Monaco's AMD loader is configured through a custom path.

## Best solution

Consolidate on https://github.com/microsoft/monaco-editor/issues/3336 and ensure published AMD assets either include their referenced source maps or omit the dangling references.

- **Proposed comment:**

  > Thanks for the report and the Vite details. This is the same missing-source-map packaging problem tracked by https://github.com/microsoft/monaco-editor/issues/3336: `min/vs/loader.js` references `../../min-maps/vs/loader.js.map`, but the package does not ship `min-maps`. Your custom `loader.config` path and the 0.55.1 Vite error are useful additional evidence for that issue, so consolidating there.
  > 
  > /duplicate of #3336

## Auto-fix candidate

- **Auto-fixable:** no
- **Rationale:** fix lane not enabled for this repository

## Evidence

- **canonical issue:** https://github.com/microsoft/monaco-editor/issues/3336 is open and broadly tracks Monaco assets referencing unavailable files under `min-maps`; it explicitly requests that all emitted source maps load correctly.
- **current source:** Current main's build/amd/src/loader.js ends with `//# sourceMappingURL=../../min-maps/vs/loader.js.map`, and build/amd/vite.config.mjs copies that file unchanged into the AMD package.
- **published packages:** Both monaco-editor 0.55.1 and current 0.56.0 contain `min/vs/loader.js` with that reference but contain no files under `min-maps/`, conclusively preserving the reported failure.
